prompt:
Use the licensed reference car for the identity and equipment of a photorealistic ordinary BMW F30 LCI four-door sedan from the 2015–2020 phase. Create a new balanced front three-quarter view between a front one-third and front one-half view, with the nose pointing right. Show the ordinary sedan’s separate trunk and four-door body through a single coherent camera, without changing it to a long-wheelbase car, Touring, M3 or M Sport.

Keep this actual car’s Glacier Silver Metallic appearance and glossy clearcoat, silver paired radial-spoke wheels with BMW centers, bonnet BMW roundel, body-color handles and both mirrors folded inward in their actual poses. Keep the LCI headlights, chrome-edged twin kidney grille, plain ordinary bumper with round fog lamps and horizontal chrome inserts, parking sensors and washer covers. Retain its actual dark rectangular sunroof and the source-visible low silver roof piece with natural self-occlusion; do not enlarge it into a taller fin or infer a hidden base. No rails, crossbars, long antenna or new badges. The cabin has a small mounted dash camera near the rearview mirror and a hanging ornament; retain these real accessories without inventing more, while keeping the cabin free of people.

Preserve the car’s shape, equipment, paint color and actual glossy material. Change the reflected environment: remove recognizable trees, foliage, sky-colored scene bands, street or paving patterns and photographer or car reflections from the paint, glass and mirrors, replacing them with clean, nonrecognizable soft studio highlights. Keep a natural silver metallic sheen and polished transitions, not matte or satin paint, flat white, or a blue repaint. Remove the trees, grassy bank, curb, asphalt and all other background. Keep the existing blank light plate and frame, without characters or labels. Factory emblems and physical trim stay intact. The factory comparison images are identity evidence only; do not copy their blue paint, wheels or unfolded mirrors.

Deliver the full car on a true transparent RGBA background. Every tire, folded mirror, roof piece and bumper corner must be completely inside the image. Leave at least 80 pixels above and at either side and 100 pixels below the tires, with the car about 78 percent of the canvas width. No floor, cast shadow, contact shadow, halo, checkerboard, watermark, caption or added text. Do not stretch the body or alter ride height to match dimensional numbers.
